artifact_observations.location: Right arm and hand crossing the chest
artifact_observations.reasoning: Significant motion blur is present on the throwing arm. While this mimics real-world photography of fast motion, AI generators often struggle to render naturalistic motion blur, sometimes resulting in 'smearing' or loss of anatomical definition at the edges. Here it looks mostly plausible but slightly soft.

The blue lettering on the chest lacks crisp edges and precise stitching detail. It appears slightly 'painted on' rather than embroidered fabric, a common subtle artifact in AI-generated sports uniforms.
The transition between the neck and the raised left shoulder is somewhat indistinct, with the collar blending into the skin tone slightly more than physically expected.
